<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>T4ROX – Team Fortnite officielle</title>
<meta name="description" content="T4ROX, team Fortnite : joueurs, stats, classement, TikTok, Twitch et Discord.">
<meta property="og:title" content="T4ROX – Team Fortnite">
<meta property="og:description" content="Les joueurs et les stats de la team T4ROX.">
<style>
:root{--bg:#fffdf7;--gl:rgba(255,255,255,.9);--bd:rgba(201,162,39,.35);--tx:#1c1606;--mut:#7a6c45;--g1:#c9a227;--g2:#e8c75a;--g3:#8a6a12;color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:radial-gradient(900px 500px at 50% -80px,rgba(212,175,55,.22),transparent),radial-gradient(600px 400px at 100% 60%,rgba(212,175,55,.08),transparent),var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Inter,sans-serif;line-height:1.4;min-height:100vh}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:rgba(255,253,247,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);z-index:30}
.gold{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#8a6a12,#c9a227 35%,#e3bd3c 50%,#c9a227 65%,#8a6a12);background-size:200% auto;-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;animation:sh 5s linear infinite}
@keyframes sh{to{background-position:200% center}}
@keyframes sp{to{transform:rotate(1turn)}}
@keyframes up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:40px 18px 8px}
.ring{position:relative;width:168px;height:168px;padding:4px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(212,175,55,.35)}
.ring:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#c9a227,#f3dc8a,#c9a227,#8a6a12,#c9a227);animation:sp 6s linear infinite}
.ring img{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%}
h1{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,11vw,4.4rem);letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:900;line-height:1}
.tag{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--mut);letter-spacing:.35em;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:uppercase}
.soc{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.soc a{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--gl);border:1px solid var(--bd);color:var(--tx);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.soc a:hover{border-color:var(--g1);color:var(--g3)}
.tot{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;max-width:760px;margin:26px auto 0}
.tot div{box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(138,106,18,.1);background:var(--gl);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 2px;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.tot b{display:block;font-size:clamp(1rem,4.6vw,1.6rem);font-weight:800}
.tot span{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.seg{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;display:flex;gap:4px;width:max-content;margin:22px auto;padding:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.88);border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:999px;backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px)}
.seg button{border:0;background:none;color:var(--mut);padding:10px 22px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.seg button.on{background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--g1),var(--g2));color:#000}
main{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 14px 50px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:14px}
.card{position:relative;padding:18px;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff,#fbf4de);border:1px solid var(--bd);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(138,106,18,.12);animation:up .6s both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i)*.1s);transition:.3s}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(212,175,55,.6);box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(212,175,55,.15)}
.rk{position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;color:#000;background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--g1),var(--g2));padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.av{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;color:#000;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--g1),var(--g2))}
h3{margin:0;font-size:1.25rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
.ep{margin:0;color:var(--mut);font-size:.78rem;word-break:break-word}
.mid{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin:18px 0 14px}
.mid svg{width:92px;height:92px}
.mid .bg{fill:none;stroke:rgba(138,106,18,.15);stroke-width:7}
.mid .fg{fill:none;stroke:url(#gd);stroke-width:7;stroke-linecap:round;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.2s}
.mid text{fill:#1c1606;font-weight:800;text-anchor:middle}
.kd{text-align:right}
.kd b{display:block;font-size:2.8rem;line-height:1;font-weight:900}
.kd span{color:var(--mut);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.2em}
.bar{margin:9px 0}
.bar p{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:0 0 4px;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--mut)}
.bar p b{color:var(--tx)}
.bar i{display:block;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:rgba(138,106,18,.12);overflow:hidden}
.bar i u{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g1),var(--g2))}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:12px 0 16px}
.chips div{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:8px 4px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(212,175,55,.12);font-size:.7rem;color:var(--mut)}
.chips b{display:block;color:var(--tx);font-size:1rem}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px}
.btn{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:11px;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid var(--bd);background:#fff;color:var(--tx);font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--g1)}
.btn.p{border:0;color:#000;background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--g1),var(--g2))}
.chp{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:26px}
.chp button{border:1px solid var(--bd);background:var(--gl);color:var(--mut);padding:8px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.chp button.on{border-color:var(--g1);color:var(--g3)}
.pod{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;gap:10px;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto}
.pc{flex:1;text-align:center;animation:up .6s both}
.pc .n{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;word-break:break-word}
.pc .v{color:var(--g3);font-weight:900;font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px}
.pc .bl{display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:2rem;font-weight:900;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(212,175,55,.55),rgba(212,175,55,.05));border:1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.4);border-bottom:0}
.sh{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.sh.on{display:flex}
.sh>div{width:100%;max-width:520px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--bd);border-radius:26px 26px 0 0;padding:22px 18px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));animation:up .3s both}
.sh h4{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.2rem}
.sh label{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--mut);margin:10px 0 3px}
.sh input{width:100%;padding:12px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--bd);background:#fffdf7;color:var(--tx);font-size:1rem}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.note{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:.75rem;margin-top:30px}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><defs><linearGradient id="gd" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#d4af37"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f7e7a1"/></linearGradient></defs></svg>
<header class="hero">
<div class="ring"><img alt="Logo T4ROX" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"></div>
<h1 class="gold">T4ROX</h1>
<p class="tag">Team Fortnite</p>
<div class="soc" id="soc"></div>
<div class="tot" id="tot"></div>
</header>
<div class="seg"><button id="t1" class="on">Équipe</button><button id="t2">Classement</button></div>
<main>
<section id="v1"><div class="grid" id="grid"></div></section>
<section id="v2" hidden><div class="chp" id="chp"></div><div class="pod" id="pod"></div></section>
<p class="note">« Tracker » ouvre le profil Fortnite Tracker du joueur.</p>
</main>
<div class="sh" id="sh"><div id="shb"></div></div>
<script>
var NAMES=["AST","VOX","BASSOUBOT"],KEY="t4rox_v7",D={},SK="kd",first=true;
var SOC=[["TikTok T4ROX","https://www.tiktok.com/@t4rox.off"],["TikTok AST","https://www.tiktok.com/@astsavage"],["Twitch","https://www.twitch.tv/ast7x"],["Discord","https://discord.gg/EthjVWWVx"]];
var ST={VOX:{kd:1.73,wins:312,kills:12601,matches:7591},AST:{kd:2.3,wins:773,kills:26173,matches:12158},BASSOUBOT:{kd:2.45,wins:52,kills:1161,matches:525}};
var PRE={AST:"TWITCH AST7X",VOX:"GRAAHH GRRAAH \u01c3",BASSOUBOT:"Mces-kane"};
try{D=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY)||"{}")}catch(e){D={}}
NAMES.forEach(function(n){D[n]=Object.assign({epic:PRE[n]||"",kd:0,wins:0,kills:0,matches:0},ST[n]||{},D[n]||{})});
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(D))}catch(e){}}
function $(i){return document.getElementById(i)}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return{"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]})}
function f(n){return Number(n).toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
function wp(p){return p.matches>0?p.wins/p.matches*100:0}
function cnt(el,to,dec){var t0=performance.now();function s(t){var k=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/1100),e=1-Math.pow(1-k,3),v=to*e;el.textContent=dec?v.toFixed(dec).replace(".",","):f(Math.round(v));if(k<1)requestAnimationFrame(s)}requestAnimationFrame(s)}
function render(){
 var t={wins:0,kills:0,matches:0},ks=0,kn=0;
 NAMES.forEach(function(n){var p=D[n];t.wins+=+p.wins;t.kills+=+p.kills;t.matches+=+p.matches;if(+p.kd>0){ks+=+p.kd;kn++}});
 var tv=[[kn?ks/kn:0,"K/D moyen",2],[t.wins,"Wins",0],[t.kills,"Kills",0],[t.matches,"Parties",0]];
 $("tot").innerHTML=tv.map(function(x,i){return'<div><b class="gold" id="c'+i+'"></b><span>'+x[1]+'</span></div>'}).join("");
 tv.forEach(function(x,i){var el=$("c"+i);if(first)cnt(el,x[0],x[2]);else el.textContent=x[2]?x[0].toFixed(2).replace(".",","):f(x[0])});
 first=false;
 var mw=Math.max.apply(null,NAMES.map(function(n){return D[n].wins}))||1,mk=Math.max.apply(null,NAMES.map(function(n){return D[n].kills}))||1;
 var ord=NAMES.slice().sort(function(a,b){return D[b].kd-D[a].kd});
 $("grid").innerHTML=ord.map(function(n,i){var p=D[n],w=wp(p);
  return'<article class="card" style="--i:'+i+'"><span class="rk">#'+(i+1)+'</span><div class="head"><div class="av">'+n[0]+'</div><div><h3>'+n+'</h3><p class="ep">'+(p.epic?esc(p.epic):"Pseudo Epic non renseign\u00e9")+'</p></div></div>'+
  '<div class="mid"><svg viewBox="0 0 80 80"><circle class="bg" cx="40" cy="40" r="33"/><circle class="fg" cx="40" cy="40" r="33" pathLength="100" stroke-dasharray="100" stroke-dashoffset="'+(100-Math.min(100,w*3))+'" transform="rotate(-90 40 40)"/><text x="40" y="43" font-size="15">'+w.toFixed(1).replace(".",",")+'%</text><text x="40" y="55" font-size="7" style="fill:#7a6c45">WIN RATE</text></svg><div class="kd"><b class="gold">'+(+p.kd).toFixed(2).replace(".",",")+'</b><span>K/D</span></div></div>'+
  '<div class="bar"><p>Wins <b>'+f(p.wins)+'</b></p><i><u style="width:'+(p.wins/mw*100)+'%"></u></i></div><div class="bar"><p>Kills <b>'+f(p.kills)+'</b></p><i><u style="width:'+(p.kills/mk*100)+'%"></u></i></div>'+
  '<div class="chips"><div><b>'+f(p.matches)+'</b>parties</div><div><b>'+(p.matches>0?(p.kills/p.matches).toFixed(1).replace(".",","):"\u2013")+'</b>kills/partie</div></div>'+
  '<div class="row"><a class="btn p" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://fortnitetracker.com/profile/all/'+encodeURIComponent(p.epic||n)+'">Tracker</a><button class="btn" onclick="edit(\''+n+'\')">Modifier</button></div></article>'}).join("");
 var L={kd:"K/D",wins:"Wins",kills:"Kills"};
 $("chp").innerHTML=Object.keys(L).map(function(k){return'<button class="'+(k==SK?"on":"")+'" onclick="SK=\''+k+'\';render()">'+L[k]+'</button>'}).join("");
 var r=NAMES.slice().sort(function(a,b){return D[b][SK]-D[a][SK]}),H=[170,130,100];
 $("pod").innerHTML=[1,0,2].filter(function(i){return r[i]}).map(function(i,j){var n=r[i],v=SK=="kd"?(+D[n].kd).toFixed(2).replace(".",","):f(D[n][SK]);
  return'<div class="pc" style="animation-delay:'+(j*.12)+'s"><div class="n">'+(i==0?"\ud83d\udc51 ":"")+n+'</div><div class="v">'+v+'</div><div class="bl" style="height:'+H[i]+'px">'+(i+1)+'</div></div>'}).join("");
 $("soc").innerHTML=SOC.map(function(x){return'<a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+x[1]+'">'+x[0]+'</a>'}).join("");
}
function edit(n){var p=D[n];$("shb").innerHTML='<h4>'+n+'</h4><label>Pseudo Epic Games</label><input id="f-epic" value="'+esc(p.epic)+'"><div class="two"><div><label>K/D</label><input id="f-kd" type="number" step="0.01" value="'+p.kd+'"></div><div><label>Wins</label><input id="f-wins" type="number" value="'+p.wins+'"></div><div><label>Kills</label><input id="f-kills" type="number" value="'+p.kills+'"></div><div><label>Parties</label><input id="f-matches" type="number" value="'+p.matches+'"></div></div><div class="row" style="margin-top:16px"><button class="btn p" onclick="ok(\''+n+'\')">Enregistrer</button><button class="btn" onclick="cl()">Annuler</button></div>';$("sh").className="sh on"}
function cl(){$("sh").className="sh"}
function ok(n){var g=function(k){return $("f-"+k).value};D[n]={epic:g("epic").trim(),kd:Math.max(0,parseFloat(g("kd"))||0),wins:Math.max(0,parseInt(g("wins"))||0),kills:Math.max(0,parseInt(g("kills"))||0),matches:Math.max(0,parseInt(g("matches"))||0)};save();cl();render()}
$("sh").onclick=function(e){if(e.target===this)cl()};
function tab(a){$("v1").hidden=a!=1;$("v2").hidden=a!=2;$("t1").className=a==1?"on":"";$("t2").className=a==2?"on":""}
$("t1").onclick=function(){tab(1)};$("t2").onclick=function(){tab(2)};
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
